name: What is the typical timeline for purchasing a home in South Florida when relocating?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for purchasing a home in South Florida when relocating?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for purchasing a home in South Florida can range from 30 to 90 days, depending on factors like market conditions, financing, and inspection periods. While some cash purchases might close faster, most transactions involve a mortgage application, which adds processing time. We advise clients to begin the pre-approval process before starting their home search to understand their budget and expedite offers. Kelby Contreras assists clients in navigating this process efficiently, ensuring timely communication and coordination among all parties involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Home purchases usually take 30-90 days, influenced by market and financing. Get pre-approved early to streamline the process.
